meta.title: Salary below the general threshold at an otherwise perfect employer

payload.requisition_text:
Junior Software Engineer
Quillstone Apps Ltd · Old Street, London

Quillstone builds white-label loyalty apps for independent coffee chains. Small team, real users, your code in production in week one.

The work: React Native features, a Node.js API, and the occasional dashboard for a franchise owner who wants to know which flat white sells best.

We hire for trajectory over polish: 0-2 years of experience, a project you can demo, and evidence you finish things.

Salary £29,500. 24 days holiday. We can support Skilled Worker visa sponsorship. Coffee, obviously, is free.

expected.determining_fact: At £29,500 the advertised salary is below the Skilled Worker general threshold, so this role cannot be sponsored regardless of the licence or the stated willingness.

evidence_anchors.willingness_quote: We can support Skilled Worker visa sponsorship

design_notes: Licence green, route green, sponsorship offered in good faith — and the number disqualifies it. £29,500 sits below the general threshold under both plausible values (30,960 and 33,400), so the label survives the threshold verification.
